why: VAMPIRES ARE THE FUEL, NOT THE ENGINE (the pilot, 2026-11-11): blood drain, life gain, action at a distance, ferocious; pings that snowball, never a two-card infinite. Cheap answers for Oliver's turn-four table (Swords, Vanishing Verse); death and drain engines that hit each opponent or draw (Teysa, Skullclamp, Zulaport, Bastion, Elas, Falkenrath Noble, Meathook); and two loop families on Pitiless Plunderer + Ashnod's Altar — Oathsworn Vampire with Blood Artist or Zulaport, and Reassembling Skeleton (stack 013, checker-passed). Iteration 2 (2026-11-12): Utter End, Wispdrinker Vampire and Malakir Bloodwitch out for Reassembling Skeleton, Zulaport Cutthroat and Bastion of Remembrance. Forge A/B (iteration 1, 200/arm, olivers-table-nov): no resolvable difference on life removed, removal cast doubled; the AI rarely assembles the loop.
